content_of_post_to_answer: Is it possible to change your mindset through repeated positive thinking, even if it feels like self-delusion?
answer: Positive thinking can change your mindset, but not because repeating a belief magically makes it true. It works when the thought becomes a lens that changes what you notice, attempt, and practice. I've written a longer exploration of this pattern on my profile for anyone curious about the difference between self-deception and self-reinforcement. A belief becomes powerful not when it ignores reality, but when it helps you engage with reality differently.
